Dear members, collaborators, friends, and fans of the QoL Lab,

Our Quality of Life Technologies Lab<
> based at the University of Geneva<

> is looking for an ambitious team member to join us in ongoing projects in the context of chronic and long-term health conditions.

We are looking for applicants with an MSc in computer science or a related field. We offer a 75–100% PhD student position for up to five consecutive years, with the completion of a PhD thesis as the intended outcome.

Details at: jobs.qol.unige.ch<

> “PhD Student in Computer Science & Computational Modelling of Health Trajectories in Chronic and Long-Term Conditions (Breast Cancer)"

Thank you for considering this opportunity and for sharing the opening with anyone who may be interested.
